description: This file implements deduplication logic for Feishu messages, including in-memory and persistent storage, with functions for message processing control, normalization, and disk warmup.

methods.name: resolveStateDirFromEnv
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for state storage based on environment variables, with special handling for test environments.

methods.name: resolveNamespaceFilePath
methods.description: Generates a safe file path for deduplication data based on the namespace.

methods.name: resolveEventDedupeKey
methods.description: Creates a deduplication key for events based on namespace and message ID.

methods.name: normalizeMessageId
methods.description: Trims and normalizes message IDs, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveMemoryDedupeKey
methods.description: Creates a memory-based deduplication key for messages.
